name: prompt-rejector
description: Screen prompts, skills and MCP tools with TypeSafe judgments and configurable reasoning models.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Required for the active TypeSafe judgments. Stored by the host as a secret.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Required for the default reasoning model. Can be empty when a custom configuration uses another provider.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Used only when your custom model configuration selects Anthropic.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Used only when your custom model configuration selects OpenAI.

ai_config.title: Custom AI configuration (optional)
ai_config.description: Select a configuration JSON to change providers/models. Leave empty to use the active TypeSafe and Gemini configuration.
